latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video Honor 400 — Convert Photos Into Shareable Videos:

- Converts JPG, PNG, HEIC, and WEBP images (up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 videos, optimized for Honor 400 smartphone users.
- Simple upload and prompt-based workflow; cloud GPU processing produces results in 30–60 seconds.
- Handles authentication and session creation automatically on first use (with 100 free credits for 7 days).
- Supports advanced features: add transitions, overlays, aspect ratio changes, audio tracks, and more from natural language prompts.
- Error handling and status updates included; supports querying credit balance, export status, and timeline previews.
- Provides clear mapping between user requests and backend actions for a streamlined editing experience.
